title: The A String: Note Locations
objectives: Find the natural notes on the A string from fret 0 to 12
payoff: You can find the root of any A-string power chord.

steps.title: A String Overview
steps.body: The A string is the 5th string.

steps.title: Play it
steps.body: Play a power chord rooted on C at the 3rd fret.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: C, D and E sit at frets 3, 5 and 7.
